title: Chapter 409
paragraphs: Chapter 409
Episode 120. Why Hairan? (3)
The intangible sword qi was wandering near Ron and Berakt, creating eerie breaking sounds.
Berakt let out a faint laugh.
"You're arrogant."
The blood flowing from his thigh was quickly stopping. It wasn't fundamentally a wound, but it seemed to be Berakt's unique method of controlling his body.
Jin felt a strange uneasiness in Berakt's smile.
No, it was more like a sense of crisis rather than uneasiness.
'Even though Sir Ron is by my side, I feel such an ominous crisis.'
The strongest warrior of the White Wolf tribe, who even Luna couldn't guarantee when they first met Murakan.
Berakt didn't seem at all surprised when his thigh was cut by Ron's intangible sword.
Instead, there was a strange pride in his eyes, as if he had met even stronger beings and had defeated them all.
'The full power of the ship Grenil hasn't been revealed yet.'
So far, it had only shown a transparent shield and thunderclouds, but that couldn't be all.
A crisis had come to Hairan.
That was a conclusion not only Jin but most of those present here had in common. Ron, who still seemed relaxed, was no exception.
Berakt adjusted his stance and began to move.
"Many humans will be swept up in the fight and die. And they will all face death because of you, Ron Hairan."
Thud, thud, crunch...!
Berakt's footsteps were getting heavier and faster.
Just 'walking,' the ground cracked, and a heavy rumble was transmitted from deep underground. It seemed as if the earth was screaming under Berakt's feet.
That walk caused an earthquake in just a few seconds.
"It would have been better if you had listened when I said I would leave peacefully."
Ron's intangible sword qi was gathering towards Berakt, but they couldn't easily reach him.
It was because the aura emanating from Berakt was distorting the surrounding space.
On the distorted space, fist-sized whirlwinds spread out, and the rocks and dirt that were lifted by the energy were sucked into the whirlwinds and turned into fine powder.
The intangible sword qi seemed to be affected by the whirlwinds' gravitational pull.
It wasn't literally disassembled like rocks or dirt clumps, but it couldn't move along the trajectory Ron originally targeted, like paper shriveling when exposed to heat.
The changed trajectory made the sword qi appear faintly colored in the sight.
The earthquake that started from Berakt's steps was getting stronger with each passing second.
When the distance between Ron and Berakt had narrowed to ten steps, Berakt struck the ground with his greatsword.
An absurdly large sword qi cut through the ground and air, rushing towards Ron. It was even larger than the sword qi Ron had fired at the ship Grenil.
Ron didn't dodge the sword qi. Instead, he moved forward and swung Rashid, and as soon as the white blade touched it, like a lie.
Berakt's sword qi disappeared.
It was a fight close to the strongest. As the two swung their swords, the battlefield's landscape changed unpredictably.
Soon, the swords of the two, who had closed the distance, touched each other.
As the greatsword and longsword collided, the ground around the two sank down as a whole. Even Jin had to pull away his body due to the powerful shockwave that tore through the surroundings.
The problem was that this one collision was only the beginning.
Kaaaah-!
Berakt and Ron's swords clashed continuously without a break, screaming. Each time, the outer walls of Sword Emperor Castle were torn apart by the spreading shockwaves.
At this rate, Sword Emperor Castle will collapse.
"Murakan!"
An ominous energy was gathering on the ship Grenil.
It was a cannon. Just like Cojek's, the barrel was filled with golden magical power. If the cannon began to fall, Sword Emperor Castle wouldn't be able to withstand it.
'For now, it won't fire the cannon. Not until Bishkel's group is secured.'
Hairan's knights were searching for Bishkel, but the situation was not easy due to the chaotic battle.
"You too, look for Bishkel!"
[Understood.]
Amid the chaotic battlefield, Jin's thoughts were also flowing complicatedly.
'Capturing Bishkel's group as hostages is important, but those guys definitely have more plans...!'
If it were him.
What choice would he make if he were Kinzelo's group that attacked Sword Emperor Castle? How to pressure Sword Emperor Castle most effectively.
Soon, Jin was able to find an answer.
'As soon as Kinzelo appeared, he purposely mentioned the name of Bishkel's group. He implied that they would leave if they were found.'
In other words, he made everyone in Sword Emperor Castle focus on Bishkel's group.
What if Dante Hairan fell into Kinzelo's hands during that time?
'The moment Dante is caught, this battle is over. Sword Emperor Castle will lose everything.'
Dante Hairan.
If Jin were part of Kinzelo's group, he would have kidnapped Dante in this situation. There was no easier way to win this battle.
He had to find Dante.
"Shuri!"
[Meow!]
Jin mounted Shuri again, looking around. Shuri still had Veradin tied to her back.
"Let's go inside the castle, we need to find Dante!"
[Meow Meow!]
Shuri leaped and started running into the battlefield, and even while fighting Ron, Berakt didn't miss that sight.
'The 12th generation of Runcandel... Is that guy really going to find Dante Hairan? Stupid, that fool should be keeping him in check.'
However, Jo had not grasped Jin's movements at all.
"Kehehehe!"
In the absence of Bishkel, Jo was dropping the ship's bombardment everywhere, laughing like a madman. He seemed completely intoxicated by the overwhelming power of the warship Grenil.
'I'm a fool for expecting that from him.'
But Berakt couldn't give Jo any orders.

If he raised his voice to give orders, the entire fortress would start searching for Dante in earnest, and as soon as Dante was mentioned, there would be no way to deny any involvement in the situation.
"Quikantel!"
Before fully entering the fortress, Jin stopped by his comrades.
[Jin.]
"We need to find Dante. Please take care of Veradin."
Jin handed Veradin over to his comrades. Coincidentally, since the others were busy, Enya ended up carrying Veradin.
"Oh, lighter than I thought... No, that's not it. Apprentice, where are you going!?"
"To the fortress, we have to find Dante Hairan. Kinzelo must be targeting him."
"You mean Commander Dante, not Commander Bishkel?"
"Bishkel too. They seem to have already been taken to a safe place, but I'm not sure. If you see them, secure them."
Jin's comrades couldn't move with him. They were responsible for a large part of the defense, and if they left their posts, it would be impossible to avoid massive casualties.
As they entered the fortress, the scene became even more chaotic.
The interior of the fortress had already collapsed under the pressure of the shockwaves from Ron and Berakt's fight.
Thankfully, the knights inside had secured an escape route to the back door, but civilians caught under the collapsing walls and ceilings were screaming in agony.
"Where is Dante Hairan?!"
"He was rescuing people in the Great Hall earlier!"
At the soldiers' response, Jin headed straight for the Great Hall. The map drawn by the servants earlier had included the Great Hall.
As soon as he entered the Great Hall,
Jin realized his judgment had been correct.
"Dante!"
Dante, surrounded by hooded assailants, came into view.
He seemed to have been fighting hard, as his breathing was labored. His clothes were also stained with blood from injuries all over his body.
There were dozens of corpses piled up near Dante. They were the Hairan servants Dante had been trying to rescue.
Even the corpses of high-ranking Hairan knights were visible. They were the corpses of high-ranking knights who had been fighting alongside Dante against the assailants just moments ago.
'They're not pushovers.'
There were only three assailants.
With just three of them, they had completely overwhelmed Dante and the high-ranking Hairan knights.
They were definitely Kinzelo's people, but no immediate names came to mind. Most of the skilled fighters in Kinzelo that Jin had encountered so far were either magicians or beastmen.
In contrast, the assailants were warriors.
Intuitively, he could tell. Unlike the gray-robed ones they had fought earlier, these were purely human swordsmen.
"From what I know, Kinzelo has been struggling with a shortage of manpower, are they finally shaping up now?"
"Jin, these guys are not ordinary."
"I know, are you alright?"
Instead of answering, Dante gave a bitter smile. As Jin approached, two of the three mysterious assailants blocked his path.
Swoosh...
The Bradamante emerged from its sheath.
"What kind of crazy things are you doing in someone else's party venue, you madmen?"
The mysterious swordsmen were the first to draw their swords.
Two of the mysterious swordsmen simultaneously lunged at Jin, and they were ferocious.
'At least 8-star level, but these two shouldn't be a problem.'
What still bothered him was the one person who continued to pressure Dante. The man had a distinctively more dangerous aura than the other two.
Perhaps even if he and Dante fought together, they might have to resort to using the Divine Sword and Demonic Sword to handle him.
Among the famous swordsmen, there weren't many who possessed such transcendent martial arts. Only those who reached the late 9-star level or were on the verge of 10-stars were relevant.

However, the possibility of such a famous swordsman unexpectedly joining Kinzelo was low. If the fight in the great hall dragged on, the other swords of Hairan would come, so even a 10-star swordsman couldn't hide behind a mask indefinitely.
Once their identity was revealed, a hostile relationship with Hairan would be inevitable.
He had to quickly deal with the two swordsmen and help Dante.
The swords of the two mysterious swordsmen cut through thin air.
The next moment, Jin was able to cut off the neck of one person with a single strike. It was because the mysterious swordsmen had fought as if they were facing a 'typical knight'.
The mysterious swordsman whose neck was cut had certainly blocked the Bradamante, but it was the black blade that had cut the swordsman's neck.
It was the second form of the Spirit Sword, Scissors, that had cut his neck.
Perhaps the remaining one hadn't expected one of his comrades to die in the first exchange against a member of the 12th Runcandel generation, so he widened the distance between them.
He still hadn't realized what had cut his comrade's neck. He merely perceived that something dark had passed by like a trick.
"You must have been prepared for death when you attacked Hairan, so you shouldn't have any regrets."
Once again, the black blade of the Scissors rushed towards the mysterious swordsman.
If he had seen it just once more, the mysterious swordsman might have been able to block the Scissors for a few moves.
Now, he realized that a blade was forming behind him, and it seemed like he couldn't avoid death.
However, the mysterious swordsman who had been fighting Dante threw himself in front of the black blade, blocking it. The impact pushed Jin back, and he took a rough breath.
The sword of the man who had blocked the Scissors felt strangely familiar, and that's when a particular group came to mind.
'...Black Knight!?'
Jin held his sword tightly and looked into the eyes of the mysterious swordsman behind the mask.
